name: add_github_actions_ci_dotnet
description: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow that builds and tests an ASP.NET Core project on every push/pull request
prompts: This repository is a small ASP.NET Core project: app.csproj and Program.cs live at the repo root, and an already-passing test project lives at tests/tests.csproj (do not modify either). Add a GitHub Actions workflow at .github/workflows/ci.yml that: triggers on both `push` and `pull_request` events; runs on `ubuntu-latest`; checks out the repository using `actions/checkout`; sets up the .NET 8 SDK using `actions/setup-dotnet` (dotnet-version 8.0.x); then runs `dotnet build` followed by `dotnet test tests/tests.csproj`, so the job fails if either command fails.

setup_files.app.csproj:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- tests/ has its own project; without this the SDK's default glob
         compiles tests/*.cs into the app itself, where xunit isn't referenced -->
    <Compile Remove="tests/**" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
setup_files.tests/tests.csproj:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <IsPackable>false</IsPackable>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk" Version="17.11.1" />
    <PackageReference Include="xunit" Version="2.9.2" />
    <PackageReference Include="xunit.runner.visualstudio" Version="2.8.2" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing" Version="8.0.10" />
    <PackageReference Include="coverlet.collector" Version="6.0.2" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="../app.csproj" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

test_setup_files.verify_ci.py:
import re, sys
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('.github/workflows/ci.yml')
assert path.is_file(), 'missing .github/workflows/ci.yml'
content = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
lower = content.lower()

checks = [
    ('has an "on:" trigger block', re.search(r'^on\s*:', content, re.MULTILINE) is not None),
    ('triggers on push', 'push' in lower),
    ('triggers on pull_request', 'pull_request' in lower),
    ('has a "jobs:" block', re.search(r'^jobs\s*:', content, re.MULTILINE) is not None),
    ('runs on ubuntu', 'runs-on' in lower and 'ubuntu' in lower),
    ('checks out the repo', 'actions/checkout' in lower),
    ('sets up .NET', 'actions/setup-dotnet' in lower),
    ('targets .NET 8', '8.0' in content or "'8'" in content or '"8"' in content),
    ('runs dotnet build', 'dotnet build' in lower),
    ('runs dotnet test', 'dotnet test' in lower),
]

failures = [name for name, ok in checks if not ok]
if failures:
    print('FAIL - missing/incorrect:', ', '.join(failures))
    sys.exit(1)

print('PASS')

reference_solution..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  build-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: 8.0.x
      - run: dotnet build
      - run: dotnet test tests/tests.csproj
